healthcare.assumption: Universal coverage eliminates household premiums/deductibles for covered care.
healthcare.mechanism: Costs shift to contributions/pooled finance; household out-of-pocket collapses.
healthcare.rationale: If care is guaranteed publicly, direct household payment drops sharply; remaining costs are minimal.

housing.assumption: Housing prices/rents follow local supply constraints and market power unless reformed.
housing.mechanism: Zoning, anti-hoarding, and ownership pathways can reduce long-run burden under WMR.
housing.rationale: Housing is the largest household cost; small percentage changes matter massively.
